title: hydnocarpus sumatranus var. pentagynus
intro: Hydnocarpus sumatranus var. pentagynus, commonly known as the Sumatran Alder or Five-petaled Hydnocarpus, is a plant species in the family Hydnoraceae. This plant is traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for its diverse health benefits, which include treating various ailments such as fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Hydnocarpus sumatranus var. pentagynus include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its use in treating infections and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include hydnocarpic acid, which has been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
